Observation: Month-to-month customers show higher churn than customers on longer contracts.
Business Action: Consider retention offers or contract incentives for month-to-month customers.

Observation: Customers with shorter tenure show higher churn rates.
Business Action: Create an onboarding and early-retention program for newer customers.

Observation: Fiber optic customers show higher churn than DSL and customers without internet service.
Business Action: Investigate service experience and support issues among fiber customers.

Observation: Higher monthly-charge groups generally show higher churn than the lowest-charge group.
Business Action: Review pricing, perceived value and service experience for higher-charge customers.
